Hi all — ops here. Confirming the execution runbook and ETA. Quoting Ben's plan for continuity.

Runbook summary (high level):
- Target objects: prompt outputs, model-generated artifacts, KV cache segments, inference request logs (app-level traces), and any cached token artifacts.
- Exclusions: billing records and long-term audit logs (we will exclude unless you instruct otherwise).
- Execution steps:
  1) Lock the account snapshot to a preservation bucket (read-only) for 24hrs in case of accidental exclusion.
  2) Run object selection: we will match objects by account tag (MC-4821) + date range.
  3) Double-verify candidates with a checksum pass; produce erase_manifest_20280705.csv (attached).
  4) Delete objects using irreversible object-delete with KMS zeroization where applicable.
  5) Produce sweep_log_snippet.txt and consolidated manifest with SHA256.
  6) Deliver signed attestation PDF and upload full evidence to s3://redwood-evidence/medicorps/ERASE-20280705/ (time-limited link).

Expected timeline: we can begin the run at 2028-07-05 21:00 PDT and complete by 2028-07-06 03:00 PDT (approx 6 hours total). We will pause for approval if we detect non-obvious candidates (e.g., artifacts that appear to be system-generated but tagged with MC-4821).

Audit ID: RW-ERASE-20280705-77
Sample confirmation email we will send upon completion (you can reuse this for your records):
